# apple_subscription_localization (Resource)

Sets a subscription's display name and description for one locale. Changes go to the version being prepared; when the current version has been reviewed, applying starts the next one. Changes fail while a version is in review. Destroying the resource deletes the localization from the version being prepared, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with `<subscription_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_localization" "en_us" {
  subscription_id = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  locale          = "en-US"
  name            = "Pro, Monthly"
  description     = "Everything in Example, billed monthly."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `name` (String) Display name, 2 to 35 characters.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, up to 55 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization, which changes with each version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_localization.en_us
  identity = {
    subscription_id = "6446452616"
    locale          = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_localization.en_us 6446452616/en-US
```
